content:
['Apple has launched a brand new accessory browsing and purchasing experience on the Apple Online Store and Apple Store app. After the changes, users can more easily browse accessories by category and view editorial picks.', 'Apple 喺 Apple Online Store 同 Apple Store app 推出全新嘅配件瀏覽同購買體驗。改版之後，用戶可以更輕鬆咁按類別瀏覽配件，並查看編輯精選產品。']

['The changes took effect last week and are available on both the Apple accessories website and the Apple Store app.', '今次改動已於上週生效，喺 Apple 配件網站同 Apple Store app 都可以用到。']

['The Apple accessories homepage has undergone a comprehensive redesign with a more modern style. Currently, the page offers the following featured category collections:', 'Apple 配件嘅主頁經過全面重新設計，風格更加現代化。目前，頁面提供以下重點類別系列：']

  • ['Campus Life', '校園生活']
  • ['Charging Essentials', '充電必備']
  • ['New Colors', '新色登場']
  • ['Travel Must-Haves', '旅行必備']
  • ['Work From Home', '居家工作']

['These categories are expected to be updated throughout the year. The website will also offer recommendations based on the items currently in your shopping bag, and you can browse accessories by product category. You can now also chat live with an Apple Specialist through the accessories website.', '預計呢啲類別將會喺全年持續更新。網站亦會根據你目前購物袋內嘅商品提供推薦，並可以按產品類別瀏覽配件。而家仲可以透過配件網站同 Apple 專員即時對話。']

['In addition to the new design, the revamped Apple accessories experience also includes improved filtering and stronger search functionality. You can still easily distinguish between accessories made by Apple and those made by third-party manufacturers.', '除咗全新設計之外，改良後嘅 Apple 配件體驗仲包括更強嘅篩選功能同更出色嘅搜尋功能。用戶仍然可以輕鬆分辨 Apple 自家出品嘅配件同第三方廠商嘅配件。']

['You can now visit the Apple website to experience the new Apple accessories page.', '你而家可以瀏覽 Apple 網站，體驗全新嘅 Apple 配件頁面。']

["Chance's Recommendations:", 'Chance 推介：']

  • ['AirPods Pro 3: $199 (originally $249)', 'AirPods Pro 3：199 美元（原價 249 美元）']
  • ['Add wireless CarPlay to any car', '為任何汽車加入無線 CarPlay 功能']
  • ['《Apple: The First 50 Years》, by David Pogue', '《Apple: The First 50 Years》，作者 David Pogue']
  • ['Logitech MX Master 4', 'Logitech MX Master 4']
  • ['Belkin 3-in-1 MagSafe Charger', 'Belkin 3 合 1 MagSafe 充電器']
  • ['Beats Woven USB-C Charging Cable', 'Beats 織物 USB-C 充電線']

['Follow Chance: Threads, Bluesky, Instagram and Mastodon.', '追蹤 Chance：Threads、Bluesky、Instagram 同 Mastodon。']
